content.bridge_context: We explore how the human body and different animals move using bones, muscles, and specialized joints.

units.title: The Skeletal System
units.explanation: Our body is supported by a framework of bones called the skeleton, which protects internal organs and allows movement.
units.dual_language_instruction: Feel your elbow, knee, and ribs. / अपनी कोहनी, घुटने और पसलियों को महसूस करें।

units.title: Types of Joints
units.explanation: Places where two bones meet are called joints. Examples: Ball and socket joint (shoulder), Hinge joint (knee).
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify which parts of your body can rotate and which can only bend. / पहचानें कि आपके शरीर के कौन से हिस्से घूम सकते हैं और कौन से केवल मुड़ सकते हैं।
